title: Free H-E-B gift card! Free Chipotle delivery! Free Chuy's entree!
description: Ring in the New Year with these freebies!

asr.full_text: A chance to give back, a chance to dress up, and a chance to stay at home. All while taking advantage of a couple of freebies. Here's this week's Friday freebies. Christmas may be over, but if you're still in the spirit of giving The South Texas Blood and Tissue Center is looking for donors. Now for the end of January you'll receive a $ excuse to dine in in the comfort of your own home, we've got you covered. You still have some time to get delivery on your Chipotle order. All you have to do is order online or on the Chipotle app. Don't forget there's a $10 minimum. The offer is valid through January 7th. If you're more in the mood to get up, get dressed, and get out for a free meal, it's now or never at Chewy's. The Tex-Mex restaurant is celebrating the King of Rock and Roll's 84th birthday on January 8th. All you have to do is show up dressed as Elvis to score a free entree. If you don't have Elvis gear, that's alright. Don't get all shook up. You can dress up as his better half, Priscilla, for the free offer as well. This freebie is one day only. As always, you can find links to these freebies on our website. Just click on the consumer section under the news tab.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as a local news consumer segment about weekly freebies and donation-related offers. The described promotions have ordinary conditions, such as online ordering with a minimum purchase or appearing in costume for a free entree. The blood-donation context and station website reference are presented as reporting and a way to find the reported links, rather than as a deceptive payment or credential-harvesting flow.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content consists of ordinary promotional benefits, including free delivery subject to a purchase minimum and a free entree subject to a costume condition, presented in a news roundup.

evidence.observation: The speaker introduces the content as a weekly roundup of freebies.
The segment reports a blood-donation opportunity connected with a stated benefit.
